description: Semantic base container for question content.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-question>
    <dl>
      <dt>Title</dt><dd>Reflection</dd>
      <dt>Prompt</dt><dd>Describe one benefit of web components.</dd>
    <dt>Form</dt><dd><tp-textfield multiline="" rows="3" placeholder="Type your answer..."></tp-textfield></dd>
      <dt>Feedback</dt><dd>Think about encapsulation and reuse.</dd>
      <dt>Solution</dt><dd>They package reusable behavior behind a custom element.</dd>
    </dl>
  </tp-question>

attributes.name: ai-api
attributes.description: Allows sending AI prompts to the selected provider; without it, prompts are only copied.

attributes.name: ai-assistant
attributes.description: AI provider, optionally followed by /model; without a model, uses the server configuration. Providers: openai, anthropic, google, mistral.

attributes.name: ai-explanation-src
attributes.description: URL of a saved Markdown explanation; the companion .prompt.md must match the current prompt.

attributes.name: ai-help
attributes.description: Optional AI assistance; solution and both enable solution explanations. Feedback assistance is reserved for a future release.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Blank mode: opened, closed, or mixed local choices.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Initial panels: both (also a bare attribute), input, or output. Absent or invalid values collapse the question.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Displays the numerical score in submission feedback.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a JSON, HTML, Markdown, reStructuredText, or AsciiDoc question definition.

attributes.name: timing
attributes.description: Optional nonzero time limit in strict hh:mm:ss format.

methods.name: setExerciseTiming(exercise: HTMLElement, pending: boolean): void
methods.description: Sets an enclosing exercise's solution gate without displaying a local timer.

events.description:

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-question>` element implements the <tp-icon name="question" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Question functionality: semantic base container for question content.
userHelp.interactions:
The user-help button legend groups commands by their location in the component and describes their effect briefly. Detailed gestures and keyboard behavior remain in the interaction tables below.

#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Question title | Expand or collapse the question. Questions start collapsed; answers are retained when collapsed. |
| Input button | Show or hide the answer form without losing answers. At least one panel stays visible. |
| Output button | Show or hide the output without losing feedback or the solution. Highlighted buttons indicate visible panels. |
| Start | Reveal the timed question and begin its countdown. |
| Continue | Reveal the question again after the time limit, keeping existing answers. |
| Explain the solution | Copy a pedagogical prompt and request an explanation when ai-api is enabled and AI is configured. |
| Submit | Check the completed answer form. |
| Feedback tab | Read feedback, or the message indicating that none is available. |
| Solution tab | Read the solution, or the message indicating that none is available. For timed questions, it becomes accessible only after Continue. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> on the question title | Expand or collapse the question. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button. |
| <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> in Output tabs | Move between Feedback and Solution. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> on Explain the solution | Copy the prompt and request an explanation when ai-api is enabled and AI is configured. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
